sponsor: City Forward Collective / CFC Action Fund

poll.source_locator: Release p.1: 'Among the 1,715 respondents included in the gubernatorial vote question, 46% support Crowley, 42% support Tiffany, 9% are unsure, and 2% say they do not plan to vote.' 'About the Poll' p.3
poll.notes: Wisconsin ADULTS, not RV/LV ('The survey is of Wisconsin adults, not exclusively registered or likely voters'). Full sample 2,000 adults; governor question base 1,715. 2% 'do not plan to vote' not counted as other or undecided. Release PDF dated 10.15.26 (sponsor web post dated Oct 16). Sponsor is a Milwaukee education-advocacy group; Wikipedia footnotes it as supporting Democrats, but no alignment shown on the primary, so UNKNOWN kept.

pollster.weighting_quote: The online survey was weighted to represent Wisconsin's adult population by demographic and political characteristics.
